title: Plastanno
description: Plastanno annotates plastid (chloroplast) genomes (CDS, tRNA and rRNA) from a FASTA file. Two independent engines (Exonerate protein2genome and profile HMMs) propose candidates, a single selector keeps one feature per locus, and every feature carries a review flag and its provenance. The reference database is archived separately on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20807994) and downloaded with plastanno fetch-db.
